title: The owner's twentieth notes: the opening runs from the landers' tour to the Rotor without a cut, the beacons light one by one as the tour reaches them, and a gust of wind in the quiet
context: Owner, 2026-10-04 (on 35a2ec80): no sound at the beginning and the Rotor's sound gone, in Safari (Chrome confirmed working); a known jump cut just before the Rotor: the view cuts twice to different views of the planet; expected a) the planet view, the beacons lit one by one, b) a dive straight to the Rotor without a cut; MuffledSoundGust5sec.mp3 as a small ambient sound in the quiet, once in a while.
outcome: The cuts, measured frame by frame (--opening-cuts): the tour's end snapped to the orbit view (0.10 of the planet's radius in a frame), the opening's breach cut away to the sinkhole (2.06) and the Rotor's hand-over shot started from a fixed pose beside the lane (2.05). Now: the tour hands over to the orbit view by easing (no snap), the opening's breach opens quiet (no cut-away; its quake still sounds), and the first hand-over dives from wherever the eye is straight down on an arc to the Rotor's shoulder (takeControlPose direct). On the way a bug of the change itself: `lit = seat && highlightSeat(...)` made lit false, `lit?.()` threw and the hand-over's end never put the camera on the optic (a 0.72 jump to the orbit distance); it is null when there is no seat. The beacons: src/domain/story-shots.js tourSeconds / tourStops give the tour's clock; each beacon is dark until the eye reaches its lander and pulses from then (lit at 2, 4.6 and 7.2 s of the tour). The gust: the owner's file, +15 dB to a -2 dB peak, pinned with the beacon ping; an `ambient` bus (0.5, ducked under Isao); src/fx/ambient-gust.js plays it when no one-shot has sounded for 9 s, then rests 40-75 s. Safari: the owner's log shows the graph healthy (signal at the output, 0.60 peak) and 9 audio contexts unclosed in the ledger; not yet reproduced, a pre-voice build is offered for an A/B by ear.
alternatives: Keeping the breach's establishing dive in the opening: it is one of the two cuts; the swarm is in the lane the dive ends looking down
Gusts on a fixed clock: a clock is heard as one; the quiet and a random rest keep it ambient
evidence: --opening-cuts (new): no frame moves the eye more than 0.06 of the radius from the tour to the Rotor's optic; before the fix 0.103, 2.063 and 2.048
test/ambient-gust.mjs; npm test, check, build green; --opening, --grow, --voice, --seat-switch and the default suite
